text: Ironvale Athletic launches a quick counterattack from a free kick near the halfway line on their own side. The ball moves through three quick passes, advancing rapidly up the right flank and cutting inside toward Redmond Rovers' penalty area. On the edge of the six-metre box, Oskar Lindgren threads a precise through ball to Jonah Lindqvist, who is positioned centrally just 4.4 metres from goal at the near end. Lindqvist strikes with his foot, scoring to put Ironvale Athletic ahead 2-1 at 61 minutes[#1153] [#1154] [#1156] [#1157].
